description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Wild Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the land tapped in step 1 and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
